title: Smooth biome relief: soft ridges, wide ramps, B-spline heights, per-biome relief in data (GenVersion 10)
player_outcome: Hills, snow ridges and mountains read as rounded rolling landforms instead of knife-edge ridges. Biome borders ramp gently instead of stepping. Slopes lose the faceted 4 m grid creases.
design: Grid2D: add `float SampleSmooth(float x, float z)`, a uniform cubic B-spline over 4×4 taps with weights (1-t)^3/6, (3t^3-6t^2+4)/6, (-3t^3+3t^2+3t+1)/6, t^3/6, using the existing clamped indexer. Only + - * / (determinism rules). Keep bilinear Sample for Landness and other masks.

TerrainField: SurfaceHeight uses _plan.Height.SampleSmooth and Ruggedness uses SampleSmooth. Detail noise becomes NoiseField.Create(seeds, "detail", 40f, Fbm, 2) with amplitude 0.8 + 1.2*land (at most 2 cells, down from 2.8; removes single-cell pimples). WorldPlan.RaiseTerrainColumnTops also samples ruggedness with SampleSmooth.

Data-driven relief: add `ReliefSpec` (Base, Rolling, Hills, Ridges, Bumps, Dunes, Ruggedness, Cliffs, Mountains {Height, Peak}) and `ReliefSpec? Relief` to BiomeDef.cs. This replaces the biome-id switch statements BiomeRelief.Relief(string) and Rugged(string).

Add DetMath.SoftRidge(float n, float k): 1 - sqrt(n*n + k*k), normalised so SoftRidge(0) = 1 and SoftRidge(±1) = 0. Only MathF.Sqrt. It gives rounded crests instead of FastNoiseLite's per-octave ridged creases.

Rewrite BiomeRelief with noise fields hills (fBm λ190, 3 oct), ridges (fBm λ240, 3 oct → SoftRidge k 0.25), bumps (fBm λ90, 2 oct), dunes (fBm λ70, 2 oct → SoftRidge k 0.12), mountain_mask (fBm λ700, 2 oct), mountains (fBm λ260, 3 oct → SoftRidge k 0.3). Relief(spec) = Base + Rolling*hills01(x,z)*hills01(0.7z,0.7x) + Hills*hills01 + Ridges*SoftRidge(ridges) + Bumps*bumps01 + Dunes*SoftRidge(dunes). Cache a ReliefSpec per region and use forest's spec for the 'no region' weight. A missing spec logs a warning and falls back to forest.
Wider ramps: weight = DetMath.SmoothStep(0f, 0.55f, r.Membership(x,z,0f)) replaces Clamp01(membership*3).
Mountains: h += mask*(m.Height + m.Peak*SoftRidge(mountains)) using forest.Relief.Mountains (22, 38) instead of 30 + 55*ridged(5 oct). Mountain ruggedness blends to 0.5 (was 0.8).
Blur: relief gets Blur(2) applied twice (about a Gaussian over ~40 cells); the rugged grid gets Blur(3) (today it is never blurred, so overhang amplitude jumps at biome borders).
ContentValidator.World.cs ValidateBiomes: range-check relief fields (base 0-40, term amplitudes 0-60, ruggedness and cliffs 0-1, mountains height 0-60, peak 0-80).
GenVersion.Current = 10 with a comment. In WorldGenTests: Assert.Equal(10, ...), re-pin the 6 golden hashes and the spawn-chunk assert.

Old worlds (player decision: disposable): WorldSession ctor logs a Warn when meta.GeneratorVersion < GenVersion.Current. Add SaveCatalog entry flag OldGenerator; MainMenu.Worlds detail line appends ' · old terrain'.
Run worldgen-report --compare against the P1b-01 baseline and attach the hillshades.
